title: Personas
summary: A Browser case sets method_config.browser_identity to a declared persona. Omitting it always uses default, including anonymous browsing when default has no sites. Set a named identity for a signed-in case. Authorize and verify use the project's default_identity for an omitted --identity; without one they refuse when default has no sites and another persona does. A qa browser call with --check-id and no --identity uses the identity that check recorded.
